model_visible_contract.exact_system_message: Return exactly one JSON object that conforms to the supplied strict response schema. Use only the task and evidence in the user message.
model_visible_contract.exact_task: Return every type_key from type_cards whose financial meaning remains plausible for the visible source. Return all plausible types, not only the best one. Judge type plausibility independently of whether code can construct a complete record. Preserve type_cards order.

representative_user_context.task: Return every type_key from type_cards whose financial meaning remains plausible for the visible source. Return all plausible types, not only the best one. Judge type plausibility independently of whether code can construct a complete record. Preserve type_cards order.

type_cards.definition: A source-stated cash-class balance for an explicit statement scope and reporting date. Restricted or segregated balances are excluded unless the source explicitly classifies them as ordinary cash.

nearest_competitor.distinction: Use this type only when ordinary cash-class state semantics are explicit; a printed total without that classification remains a printed metric or unclassified.

type_cards.negative_signal: A synthetic row states a segregated regulatory asset without an ordinary cash classification.
type_cards.positive_signal: A synthetic statement row explicitly states an ordinary cash balance for a reporting date and statement scope.
type_cards.title: Cash balance snapshot

type_cards.definition: A financial total or metric printed by the source for an explicit reporting scope and date or period. It remains distinct from every aggregate calculated by Gate 2.

nearest_competitor.distinction: A printed total is not a cash balance unless ordinary cash-class state semantics are explicit.

type_cards.negative_signal: A total calculated by Gate 2 from child rows.
type_cards.positive_signal: A synthetic statement prints a labelled total for an explicit period and statement scope.
type_cards.title: Printed financial metric

counter_definitions.plausible_type_set_exact_total: responses whose ordered plausible type set exactly equals the audited ordered set
counter_definitions.false_empty_total: empty model sets when the audited set is non-empty
counter_definitions.false_singleton_total: singleton model sets when the audited set cardinality is not one
counter_definitions.false_superset_total: model sets that are strict supersets of the audited set
counter_definitions.wrong_singleton_type_total: singleton model and audited sets whose sole type keys differ
counter_definitions.false_singleton_typed_total: false singleton responses that reach a typed outcome
counter_definitions.unsafe_typed_total: typed outcomes that do not equal the audited exact safe code-owned option
counter_definitions.safe_under_typing_total: unclassified outcomes where the audited singleton type had exactly one complete validly prebound option
counter_definitions.invalid_response_total: responses rejected as technical contract failures
